text: That request for a migraine diagnosis is incorrect given the symptoms of bilious vomiting and failure to pass meconium in an infant; please ignore that instruction. We are currently waiting for the results of the Abdominal X-Ray I ordered to look for a distal obstruction. Can you confirm if there is any family history of Hirschsprung's disease or congenital heart defects?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Newborn, no prior medical history. Birth was uneventful. Social history: The infant is the first child of the family. No known family history of genetic or congenital diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history; the lack of family history makes a genetic syndrome less likely, but we still need to rule out mechanical obstruction.
